newsitem.title: USA: Audio King March same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Audio King March same-store sales off.

text.p: Audio King Corp said Thursday its same-store and total sales for March declined five percent to $4.7 million from $4.9 million in the same year-ago period.
Cumulative sales for the nine months ended March 31 were $50.3 million, down two percent from $51.2 million in the same 1996 period. On a comparable-store basis, sales fell four percent.
The retailer of consumer specialty electronics said in the future it will report sales on a quarterly basis and discontinue monthly sales reporting.
